rule_gaps: Kicks feed rows (srcCat empty) append the shade/size label to a name that already ends with it — 'Fiji Fiji', '30 ml 30 ml', and 'NARS #16 Blush Brush' three times: 49 rows in this shard alone. Strip a repeated trailing tail at ingest instead of patching row by row.

facetrules Beauty 'type': 'Mousse'/'Cream' pull face and lip products into Hair care (NIVEA Caring Cleansing Mousse, Morphe Soulmatte Velvet Lip Mousse), and the literal word 'Fragrance' types 'Neccin Shampoo Fragrance Free' as Fragrance — the exact opposite of the truth. Prefer the srcCat leaf over the name token for 'type'.
Brushes, sponges and powder puffs land on 'Face makeup' instead of 'Tools' — srcCat 'Sminke > Koster' / 'Blending sponge' should force Tools.
spf is not derived from the '<n>+' form ('NIVEA Sun UV Fluid Medium Tinted 50+').

Beauty shops' non-beauty shelves promote straight into Beauty: supplements and food ('Kollagen', 'Immunforsvar', 'Buljong', 'Drikkevare' → Health), eyewear ('Solbriller & Briller' → Fashion), jewellery ('Smykker … Øredobber', 'Hoops' → Jewelry), nursing ('Brystpumpe' → Baby) and home fragrance ('Dufter til hjemmet' → Home). Also 'Primer' in a Jernia paint breadcrumb read as makeup primer — the paint sense needs to beat the cosmetic one when the crumb contains 'Maling og oppussing'.
notes: Beauty proper is in good shape — the 250-odd skincare/haircare/fragrance rows are correctly categorised and mostly correctly faceted; nearly all the damage is at the edges (14 rows that are not beauty products at all) plus one mechanical feed defect (duplicated name tails) that is worth fixing in the crawler rather than by patch. 145 of 300 rows (48%) still have no image, consistent with the sampled-crawl state; not reported per row.
